sections.title: Get Well Soon
sections.passage:
Hi Jane,

Aren't you any better yet? Old Woodsy's more bad-tempered than ever and none of us can get round him. He timed our morning break today- said we were 5 minutes too long. We can't stand it much longer. Get well real soon!!

From all of us at the office (except Grumpy).

responses.prompt: Why do they want Jane to get better quickly?
responses.response: because Woodsy's got more bad-tempered than ever with jane there it might help

questionScores.rationale: Correctly links Woodsy's bad temper to Jane's absence and suggests her presence would help, matching the intended inference.
